features.name: Offline Remote Data editing
features.details: Create, open, edit, and save local Remote Data JSON files without a runtime network dependency.

features.name: Device library and editor
features.details: Browse devices by category and brand; add, edit, and remove local devices and parsed command data.

features.name: Flipper IR file import
features.details: Imports supported parsed IR signals only. Raw, malformed, or unsupported records are rejected.

features.name: Activity sequence builder
features.details: Build ordered local command sequences; select participating devices, channel/volume control devices, and target inputs. Remote Data edits are not yet transferable to the remote.

features.name: Activity icons
features.details: Built-in and custom PNG/GIF icon previews are stored in local Remote Data. Existing remote icons cannot yet be decoded and icon edits cannot be uploaded.

features.name: Bundled IR catalog
features.details: Includes 82 curated device profiles with 1,956 parsed commands, added on demand through 'Add from IR library...' on the Devices tab. New Remote Data starts blank. It is not a complete database, and codes are not verified for every model.

features.name: Logitech USB device discovery
features.details: Windows discovery lists connected Logitech USB/HID devices for information. Discovery does not enable remote programming.

features.name: Harmony One configuration backup
features.details: Reads and validates the connected Harmony One's complete raw configuration and saves it as an .EZHex snapshot. This is separate from the editable Remote Data JSON and does not write to the source remote.

features.name: Import a remote backup into the editor
features.details: Reads a backup and imports decoded devices, IR records, activity names, and state steps. The editor supports local participant, role, input, and sequence edits; button-map editing and configuration generation are not yet available.

features.name: Export device and activity objects
features.details: Exports separate JSON objects with recovered IR timings, activity steps and source key maps. Individual devices and activities can be selected, including straight from a fresh USB backup, and files are named after the objects. Decoding is incomplete and transfer to another remote is not yet implemented.

features.name: Browse devices and activities inside a backup
features.details: Browse Contents takes a fresh USB snapshot or opens a saved .EZHex file, lists decoded devices and activities, and imports all decoded items into a separate Remote Data project with one action. Icon edits and display-style candidates start from the loaded backup; the complete original is protected from overwrite. General Remote Data device/activity edits remain separate and are not compiled into an .EZHex.

features.name: Edit individual remote menu icons
features.details: Edit one specific device/activity menu-page occurrence using a 51 x 48 image already in the backup or a PNG/GIF import. Candidate checks preserve the other recognized icons, menu backgrounds, buttons, and decoded remote data. Candidates must be saved as a new .EZHex file before transfer; hardware appearance and cross-remote compatibility are unverified.

features.name: Visual configuration memory map
features.details: The Memory Map tab displays the complete saved configuration as header, raw-numbered data sections, and checksum/end-marker blocks, with proportional sizes, file offsets, flash addresses, and a short hex preview. Section contents are not all semantically decoded; the page is read-only and can open a backup without USB.

features.name: Move individual objects between local Remote Data files
features.details: Export and import one Remote Data device or activity at a time. Activity packages include dependent devices and remap local IDs. Packages are not upload-ready; remote-decoded commands may be placeholders.

features.name: Reorder devices/activities and add delay steps
features.details: Order lists show remote pages (3 per page). Activities show Start and Done rows and accept delays of 100-10000 ms. Order is saved in local Remote Data only.

features.name: Read remote, preview and gate writes
features.details: Scanning a remote into the local editor first asks the user to confirm it is connected and charged, saves a timestamped raw .EZHex backup, and imports decoded data into a separate Remote Data project copy. Opening a loaded backup from Browse Contents does the same without another USB scan. General local JSON edits are not compiled into .EZHex or uploaded.

features.name: Activities and Devices display styles
features.details: Transfers Activities and Devices list backgrounds and row-button artwork from the included Newer and Older styles or a locally saved custom style created from a backup. Every recognized row icon is replaced with the same generic list icon so no per-item icon artwork remains mixed with the selected style. Labels, device/activity data, and order are preserved. In-app previews show the generic icon. Custom styles are stored locally for reuse. An acknowledgement-gated USB writer requires a fresh exact-match backup and verifies the full configuration after writing. Display-style writes have not yet been hardware-validated.

features.name: Set the Harmony One clock
features.details: The Clock tab can save a clock candidate based on the currently loaded .EZHex backup without touching USB, or write the clock using an acknowledgement-gated fresh exact-live-baseline USB workflow. Clock-specific hardware behavior and resulting accuracy have not yet been verified.

features.name: Restore a complete Harmony One save
features.details: The Transfer Remote tab can scan a source remote over USB and save its raw .EZHex configuration, then direct the user to disconnect it and connect a different destination remote. It saves a fresh destination backup, checks architecture and screen skin, requires explicit charged-target/full-replacement confirmations, and verifies the write. It replaces the destination's complete configuration and does not apply editable Remote Data JSON. Firmware and cross-remote compatibility are not hardware-validated.

features.name: Program a remote from this app
features.details: Fixed-size slideshow replacements and one same-length activity-name edit have been written and read-back verified on the spare Style A remote. A complete existing save can be restored to a matching architecture/skin target, but edited Remote Data cannot be converted into a remote configuration because general configuration generation and relocation are not implemented.

features.name: Add an activity using existing remote devices
features.details: Experimental GUI workflow reads a fresh backup, composes locally using attributed MIT code, checks preservation and offers acknowledgement-gated USB upload. Test TV upload and screen repair were read-back verified; the owner confirmed the corrected device-button panel and original FQS1 activity. Startup title still shows the template name. Requires Node.js; extra startup sends/delays are not copied, and the template working screen is shared.

features.name: Generate remote-specific configurations
features.details: The app cannot generate the remote-specific configuration blobs needed to transfer edited devices and activities.
